lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x30x40 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 36.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 30x30x40 cm terrarium (36 L) stands out with a polystyrene 3D background that we shape and paint by hand. The background evokes a rocky or forest setting and gives animals functional surfaces for moving vertically.

The vertical format (a height of 40 cm, greater than the 30 cm length) is meant for arboreal species that spend most of their time on branches and leaves. The height leaves room for branches, vines and plants at different levels. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

When ordering, you choose the decorative film, the 3D background style and the ventilation type. Non-standard dimensions, LED lighting and a thermostat are available as options. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for full details. Delivery across Serbia.
